title: How to Speed up a Python Program 114,000 times.
summary: David Schachter describes how he made a data-collection Python program run 114,000 times faster, drawing on decades of experience. The talk covers pipelining, cache effects and other optimization lessons.
why: A favorite tech talk on HN for showing that hardware knowledge and generalist skills beat simply adding machines.

quote.text: Humour, serious technical insight and a good reminder of why being a generalist is an advantage.
